scope: Static HTML attributes and source-text evidence only. Referenced stylesheets and imports are scanned with a conservative URL pattern; no JavaScript execution, network requests or user storage inspection. Query strings omitted.

assumptions.local: Node server: / maps to main.html; directory paths are not served.
assumptions.pages: Project base /datalab/; root-relative HTML attribute URLs modeled after build-pages.mjs; directories map to index.html.
assumptions.evidence: Tokens, element counts and controller script references identified by filename are static evidence only; empty results do not mean absence, and none establish runtime behavior or complete dependencies.
assumptions.external: All absolute and protocol-relative URLs, including same-site hostnames, are excluded from validation and redacted; host equivalence is not inferred.
assumptions.srcset: Static candidates only; complex data URI forms may need manual review.
assumptions.css: CSS url() and quoted @import are heuristic; dynamically generated CSS, escaped syntax and conditional loading are not evaluated. Unquoted root URLs are not rewritten by the Pages build.
assumptions.anchors: Static id and named-anchor attributes only; dynamically created anchors are not checked.
assumptions.routes: Duplicate checks cover canonical source-derived URLs; index aliases are implicit and runtime redirects are not verified.
